actionable_steps.citation: Be Ever Grateful To God (Alternative Translation) — SSS Vol 29 (1996), 1996-08-17
actionable_steps.step: Make prayer your gratitude — expression of gratitude is itself prayer; thank God for food, air, water, and life itself.

actionable_steps.citation: Mother Is Your First God — SSS Vol 35 (2002), 2002-05-06
actionable_steps.step: Be ever grateful even for a small help — never be ungrateful; ingratitude is utter cruelty.
When you go to bed, offer thankful homage to Him for guiding and guarding you throughout the day.

actionable_steps.citation: From the Mother to Moksha — SSS Vol 20 (1987), 1987-05-06
actionable_steps.step: Show gratitude to your parents, starting with mother, then father, then preceptor — grace comes to those grateful to their parents.

actionable_steps.citation: Mother Is Your First God — SSS Vol 35 (2002), 2002-05-06
actionable_steps.step: Return help for help to the utmost extent possible — any help received should be reciprocated.
Share the bliss you receive from God with others — real gratitude is to take bliss from God and share it with others.

definition.citation: No Greater Sin Than Ingratitude — SSS Vol 25 (1992), 1992-05-10
definition.quote: Gratitude is a great virtue. When the power of gratitude is realised, it will be seen that it can give benefits much more than anyone can imagine. If out of narrow-mindedness, men become ungrateful, they will suffer grievously.

discourses.citation: Be Ever Grateful To God (Alternative Translation) — SSS Vol 29 (1996), 1996-08-17
discourses.quote: Expression of gratitude is itself prayer... Isn't it our duty to express gratitude to God, who has created this vast world and all the living beings in it and provided them with food to eat, air to breathe, and water to drink?
What is the true gift you must give God? Only gratitude... Real gratitude is to take bliss from God and share it with others.

discourses.citation: Mother Is Your First God — SSS Vol 35 (2002), 2002-05-06
discourses.quote: Be ever grateful even for a small help. Do not be a kritaghna (ungrateful). Ingratitude is utter cruelty.

When you go to bed, offer thankful homage to Him for guiding and guarding you throughout the day... how much more gratitude should you evince to God who watches you and wards off all harm threatening to overwhelm you.

make_it_real: Gratitude is the breath of devotion — inhale His gifts, exhale thankfulness, and share the bliss.
title: Gratitude

vahinis.quote: "My austerities, vows, and yearning have at last yielded fruit today. I must confer on Kaika my heartfelt gratitude and a share of the bliss I am now enjoying." Valmiki sat long in silence, with his eyes closed, trying to control the emotions of gratitude and joy surging inside him. Tears gathered in his eyes, tears of spiritual bliss (ananda), and they rolled down his cheeks in big drops that chased each other.
